evidence.title: Thousands of European wind and solar power systems exposed online, Dutch researchers say

occurrences.checkable_against: ONE Conference program or presentation records in The Hague
occurrences.quote_span: El Yadmani and Bouke van Laethem of the Dutch National Cyber Security Centre presented their findings on Tuesday at the ONE Conference in The Hague.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internet-facing wind and solar power systems in Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: Dutch researchers' documented turbine web page example
occurrences.quote_span: One turbine's web page showed live data, "Start, Stop and Reset" buttons and the turbine's location, the research said.
occurrences.speaker: the research
occurrences.subject: Internet-facing wind and solar power systems in Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: Dutch researchers' report and underlying geographic linkage dataset
occurrences.quote_span: in 35 European countries
occurrences.speaker: Soufian El Yadmani and Bouke van Laethem
occurrences.subject: Internet-facing wind and solar power systems in Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: Reuters' requests for comment and responses from authorities in Germany, Italy and Spain
occurrences.quote_span: Authorities in Germany, Italy and Spain did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internet-facing wind and solar power systems in Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: Dutch researchers' site-level exposure analysis
occurrences.quote_span: However, one of the researchers, Soufian El Yadmani, from internet-scanning company Modat, told Reuters that researchers believed full control would have been possible in the case of around 181 sites.
occurrences.speaker: Soufian El Yadmani
occurrences.subject: Internet-facing wind and solar power systems in Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: Dutch researchers' exposure assessment of European wind and solar power park systems
occurrences.quote_span: Thousands of administrative systems at wind and solar power parks in Europe are exposed to the internet, potentially giving attackers access to interfaces that can stop turbines and raising the risk of sabotage, Dutch researchers warned on Tuesday.
occurrences.speaker: Dutch researchers
occurrences.subject: Internet-facing wind and solar power systems in Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: Dutch researchers' classification of exposed systems
occurrences.quote_span: Most of the systems found were admin pages with login screens.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internet-facing wind and solar power systems in Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: Dutch researchers' methodology for linking exposed systems to specific sites
occurrences.quote_span: The researchers said the rankings partly reflected where they had been able to link systems to specific sites.
occurrences.speaker: the researchers
occurrences.subject: Internet-facing wind and solar power systems in Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: Dutch researchers' report and underlying internet scan dataset
occurrences.speaker: Soufian El Yadmani and Bouke van Laethem
occurrences.subject: Internet-facing wind and solar power systems in Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: European Union Agency for Cybersecurity response records
occurrences.quote_span: The European Union Agency for Cybersecurity could not immediately comment.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internet-facing wind and solar power systems in Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: Dutch researchers' inventory and classification of exposed interfaces
occurrences.quote_span: The exposed systems included administrative and login interfaces as well as operational interfaces showing data and controls.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internet-facing wind and solar power systems in Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: Dutch researchers' country-level exposure counts
occurrences.quote_span: Spain had the most exposed solar systems, with 2,766, followed by Greece with 1,860, they said.
occurrences.speaker: Soufian El Yadmani and Bouke van Laethem
occurrences.subject: Internet-facing wind and solar power systems in Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: Dutch researchers' report and underlying internet scan dataset
occurrences.speaker: Soufian El Yadmani and Bouke van Laethem
occurrences.subject: Internet-facing wind and solar power systems in Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: Dutch researchers' system capability assessment
occurrences.quote_span: Some systems controlled several turbines or a whole farm.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internet-facing wind and solar power systems in Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: Dutch researchers' country-level wind-system exposure counts
occurrences.quote_span: with Italy close behind at 192.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internet-facing wind and solar power systems in Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: CERT Polska analysis of the December 2025 attack on wind and solar sites in Poland
occurrences.quote_span: The report listed among its sources the Polish cybersecurity team CERT Polska's analysis of a December 2025 attack on 30 wind and solar sites in Poland, an example of the potential threat.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internet-facing wind and solar power systems in Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: Russian government statements regarding alleged sabotage and cyberattacks on European critical infrastructure
occurrences.quote_span: Russia denies any involvement.
occurrences.speaker: Russia
occurrences.subject: Internet-facing wind and solar power systems in Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: European solar capacity statistics and Dutch researchers' exposure counts
occurrences.quote_span: Germany has Europe's most installed solar capacity, and 672 exposed solar systems.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internet-facing wind and solar power systems in Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: Dutch researchers' country-level wind-system exposure counts
occurrences.quote_span: However it had the most exposed wind systems with 212, with Italy close behind at 192.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internet-facing wind and solar power systems in Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: Dutch researchers' report and underlying internet scan dataset
occurrences.quote_span: Using machine learning to sort and cluster data, the pair said they identified 8,547 internet-facing systems they could link to at specific solar parks (7,942) and wind farms (605) in 35 European countries, which should not have been exposed to the internet.
occurrences.speaker: Soufian El Yadmani and Bouke van Laethem
occurrences.subject: Internet-facing wind and solar power systems in Europe
